justification: Both surfaces show a highly similar schematic anthropomorphic figure: a large block-headed body with incised linear markings on the head, side projections, paired rounded upper-body forms with circular depressions, and central body markings. The biggest depicted-content difference is that A presents a frontal face and more explicit chest/belly motifs, while B shows the rear/side of the figure with mainly vertical head/back markings and no clear frontal face.
